name: Can I build on the site of a demolished pool?

mainEntity.name: Can I build on the site of a demolished pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building on the site of a demolished pool is possible, but it requires careful planning and execution, especially if you opted for a partial demolition. For any future construction, especially involving foundations, a full pool demolition with proper engineered backfill and compaction is highly recommended. The soil must be stable and structurally sound to support new structures. A geotechnical engineer may be consulted to assess the soil conditions and certify the compaction. This ensures the integrity of any new construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can build on a demolished pool site, but a full demolition with proper engineered backfill is crucial for structural integrity, especially for new construction.
